biotools.summary: EasyAmplicon is a user-friendly, automated pipeline designed for the analysis of high-throughput amplicon sequencing data, particularly in microbiome research. It provides a streamlined workflow from raw data through diversity analysis and visualization.
biotools.name: EasyAmplicon: Amplicon Sequencing Data Analysis Pipeline
